title: Car Rental Under 25 Deposit: Available Funds, Holds and Refunds
answer: There is no single confirmed deposit amount for every under-25 rental. Obtain the pickup location's required available funds in addition to the rental estimate, and identify whether the money is authorized or actually charged. Enterprise distinguishes credit-card release from debit-card refund; Hertz publishes different amounts across its official pages; Avis's debit policy gives no fixed extra amount or posting deadline. A young-driver fee is a charge, not automatically a refundable deposit.
html:
Car Rental Under 25 Deposit: Available Funds, Holds and Refunds

There is no single confirmed deposit amount for every under-25 rental. Obtain the pickup location's required available funds in addition to the rental estimate, and identify whether the money is authorized or actually charged. Enterprise distinguishes credit-card release from debit-card refund; Hertz publishes different amounts across its official pages; Avis's debit policy gives no fixed extra amount or posting deadline. A young-driver fee is a charge, not automatically a refundable deposit.

What the three companies actually publish

U.S. source review: October 21, 2026. The following describes money handling only. It does not establish that a particular under-25 renter qualifies to use a debit card. A published general amount is not a branch-specific approval or a tested rental quote.

CompanyDeposit, authorization and return of fundsWhat does not constitute approval
Enterprise deposit refundsDeposit varies by location and vehicle; no single amount is given. Credit card: rental cost plus deposit authorized at pickup, authorization released immediately on return and actual rental charged. Debit: cost plus deposit charged at pickup, deposit refunded to the checking account; approximately 5–10 business days, bank dependent.An immediate authorization release is not a promise of immediate bank posting. A debit refund timetable does not establish debit-card eligibility.
Hertz payment terms and official debit-card articlePayment terms describe estimated charges plus an authorization of up to US$500 under stated conditions. The debit article instead names a $500 deposit; its credit-card section says estimated rental plus up to $350. That article says the debit deposit is usually sent back within 24 hours, with 5–10 days to appear; it does not label those days business or calendar.These official statements have different scopes/wording. Do not select the smallest amount as your branch's requirement or interpret a usual return time as guaranteed access to money.
Avis debit-card policyAn authorization generally covers estimated rental charges; Avis can request extra value. The funds are unavailable for use. It describes reversal/release at the end of the rental and additional bank posting time, but gives no numeric posting period or fixed extra amount. A credit-card hold amount is not established by this debit-policy source.Enough money for the advertised rent alone does not establish enough available funds. The policy does not supply a universal refund date or approval of this driver's payment arrangement.

Download the deposit and funds-preparation comparison (CSV)

Keep the other decisions separate: which company can rent to you, debit-card pickup qualification, adding a driver and vehicle classes and upgrades each have their own guide.

How much should remain available?

The Hertz payment page ties its extra authorization to conditions explained at rental. It can obtain further authorizations if the return is late or changed rental terms create additional charges. Its available-credit requirement is different from a card's overall limit. The debit article does not resolve the difference between its amounts and that payment page for an unspecified booking. The applicable amount remains unconfirmed until the location supplies its terms.

For Enterprise, the refund FAQ says unplanned fuel, damage or late-return charges can reduce the returned deposit. It directs the customer to the branch if a debit refund has not appeared after 10 business days. This is not a new nationwide deposit figure.

Our preparation method starts with the actual rental estimate and asks what it already contains. Record any applicable young-driver charge within that estimate before adding the separately stated security requirement. Do not count a fee twice just because it has its own line on the receipt. Do not assume a prepayment means no additional funds are needed at pickup, either.

Use the location's stated authorization or collection basis, not a homemade total assembled from unrelated pages. Where the written requirement is estimated charges plus an extra amount, those are the inputs to add. If the location quotes a single inclusive collection amount, first determine what it includes. This worksheet contains no guessed rental price, assumed deposit or calculated universal balance.

Three money categories, not three refundable deposits

Pickup authorization or security collection. This is the money-management event at the start. Record whether it is a pending authorization, an actual debit or another collection method. Only then can you ask whether the end event is a reversal, a refund or settlement against the final bill.

Young-driver charge within the rental cost. Keep this as a rental charge unless the applicable terms establish a waiver or refund. It can be included in the estimated amount secured at pickup. It is not an additional pot of refundable money merely because the driver is young. This page does not re-price the age fee.

Fuel, damage or other charges determined later. Track the final itemized bill and the amount retained or additionally charged. A smaller returned security amount may require reconciliation with those items. Calling everything a deposit conceals which part was charged for a service and which part was security awaiting release.

These are our editorial accounting categories. They do not mean every company creates three separate transactions or that the customer should add three amounts to a quoted inclusive authorization. Their purpose is to stop a rental fee being mistaken for a refund, and a pending amount being mistaken for a final charge.

When does the money become usable again?

The return date, the company's release or refund action, and the bank's posting date belong in different fields. A message saying released answers only the company's action. It does not, on its own, establish the balance currently available to spend. Preserve the payment method and transaction type alongside the message.

Enterprise's credit and debit descriptions are different processes. Hertz's usual timing in the reviewed article leaves the type of day unspecified. Avis provides no numeric bank-posting deadline in the reviewed debit policy. Our comparison preserves those differences instead of converting all three into a calendar countdown.

For planning, leave an unknown posting date unknown. Do not promise that a later hotel payment can use the same money simply because the rental has ended. Nor should a traveler treat a pending authorization disappearing as a fresh cash credit without checking how the original transaction was recorded.

Funds evidence that answers the right question

Ask the station for the total available funds or credit required, the collection method, and any documents it requires for the actual reservation. A balance screenshot has not been established here as a substitute for authorization on the qualifying card. Do not send bank passwords, full card numbers or unredacted statements with a routine inquiry.

Our CSV pairs each money event with its evidence: the pickup estimate and authorization/charge record; the final itemized rental bill; and the release/refund confirmation plus bank posting status. It also leaves space for the destination account or card confirmed by the company. Apart from Enterprise's stated checking-account debit refund, no universal alternative refund destination was established in these sources.

A displayed balance is not the whole answer. Record the amount available for use and the location's required amount separately. If a quoted security figure is a maximum or a conditional amount, keep that qualification attached. Do not turn it into a fixed approval threshold for every reservation.

A release is not necessarily a refund entry. Ask which transaction was reversed or refunded before looking for a matching incoming payment. If the bank still shows unavailable funds, retain the dated company confirmation and ask the issuer about that identified transaction. This is a recordkeeping method, not a promised resolution period.

A smaller refund is not explained by age alone. Reconcile it with the final bill rather than inventing a non-refundable under-25 deposit. If the receipt and returned money do not reconcile, the missing item remains unresolved. Do not fill that gap with another traveler's deposit experience.

No reservation, authorization, bank transaction or refund was tested for this article. Amounts and timing above come from the linked official pages read on October 21, 2026; local terms and banking processes can differ or change. Obtain the applicable current terms and retain the records for your own rental.
